stories.title: Dolphins ship QB Ewers to Jaguars for draft pick
stories.summary: On Saturday, the Jacksonville Jaguars traded for quarterback Quinn Ewers, 23, who played in four games last season and completed 66.3% of his passes, sending a sixth-round pick in 2028 to the Miami Dolphins for the second-year player, the teams announced.

stories.title: 'This is step No. 1': NDSU wins 1st-ever FBS game
stories.summary: Nathan Hayes completed 14 of 22 passes with two touchdowns, and Myles Mitchell ran for 74 yards, as North Dakota State, a former FCS power that owns 10 national titles, raced to a 33-7 win over Jacksonville State in the Bison's first FBS game on Saturday.

stories.title: Messi scores 4 as Inter Miami net 7 in record win
stories.summary: Lionel Messi scored four goals to lift Inter Miami to a club-record 7-1 victory over visiting CF Montréal on Saturday and snap the team's winless run in style.
